sources.title: Dark Matter Relics and the Expansion Rate in Scalar-Tensor Theories

evidence.text: Can thermal dark matter reproduce the assumed observed abundance with annihilation cross sections larger or smaller than standard-cosmology values, through scalar-tensor modifications of pre-BBN expansion?

sources.title: Primordial Extremal Black Holes as Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can primordial black holes below the ordinary evaporation-survival mass constitute dark matter through dark-charge near-extremality, and can their mergers produce observable Hawking-radiation transients or constrain a dark-sector weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: A Mini Review of some Dark Matter/BSM Physics and a Bit More

evidence.text: Which connections between dark matter candidates, underlying BSM physics, cosmological consistency and detection strategies provide useful physical insights? This is a subjective review, including excluded or potentially excludable ideas, rather than a systematic assessment of surviving models.

sources.title: Near Threshold Kaluza-Klein Graviton Decays and the Dark Dimension

evidence.text: What is the near-threshold partial-wave suppression of intra-tower KK graviton decays, and does the resulting cascade rate permit dark-dimension graviton dark matter or evade bounds from unavoidable freeze-in production?

sources.title: Dark Matter and Dark Radiation

evidence.text: Can dark matter carry an unbroken long-range U(1)D interaction while satisfying thermal-relic, radiation-density and galactic-dynamics constraints, and could the resulting neutral dark plasma have observable collective effects?

sources.title: Searching for the light dark gauge boson in GeV-scale experiments

evidence.text: Which low-energy experiments can constrain or discover a weakly coupled, roughly hundred-MeV to GeV dark vector, and what fixed-target designs could extend sensitivity beyond existing collider and meson-decay samples?

sources.title: New cosmological constraints on primordial black holes

evidence.text: How do quark/gluon emission and updated light-element and photon-background observations constrain the initial PBH abundance over 10^9–10^17 g? The paper also reviews constraints extending to much larger, nonevaporating PBHs.

sources.title: Dark Matter Candidates from Particle Physics and Methods of Detection

evidence.text: Which dark matter candidates motivated by particle physics problems have viable production mechanisms, and how could laboratory, collider and astrophysical observations identify them?

sources.title: Dynamical Dark Matter: I. Theoretical Overview

evidence.text: Can a large ensemble of unstable dark-matter components remain cosmologically viable by balancing shorter lifetimes against smaller abundances, and can a Kaluza–Klein tower naturally realize this balance?

sources.title: Double-Disk Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can a subdominant interacting dark-matter component satisfy the paper's observational bounds, dissipate energy into a galactic disk and produce distinguishable gravitational or particle-detection signatures?

sources.title: Cold dark matter: controversies on small scales

evidence.text: Can baryonic galaxy-formation physics resolve the central-density and satellite discrepancies of collisionless CDM simulations, or do these discrepancies require different dark-matter properties?

sources.title: Dark Radiation constraints on minicharged particles in models with a hidden photon

evidence.text: How do production, partial thermalization and decoupling of minicharged fermions and massless hidden photons determine dark radiation during BBN and recombination, and constrain their masses and couplings?

sources.title: Dark matter self-interactions via collisionless shocks in cluster mergers

evidence.text: Can collective plasma effects make a subdominant charged dark-matter component effectively collisional in cluster mergers, despite negligible binary scattering, while allowing thermal production and compatibility with the cosmological constraints considered?

sources.title: Non-Abelian dark matter and dark radiation

evidence.text: Can WIMP dark matter charged under a very weak non-Abelian gauge group produce distinctive particle-search signals, interacting dark radiation and smooth suppression of structure?

sources.title: Millicharge or Decay: A Critical Take on Minimal Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can Minimal Dark Matter remain viable when electric neutrality or a Planck-scale cutoff is relaxed, and what relic-abundance and gamma-ray signatures follow?

sources.title: A new constraint on millicharged dark matter from galaxy clusters

evidence.text: Can preservation of observed, gravity-dominated galaxy-cluster dark-matter profiles constrain a small dark-matter electric charge through the effects of cluster magnetic fields?

sources.title: Primordial Black Hole production in Critical Higgs Inflation

evidence.text: Can critical Higgs inflation, including running of both the Higgs self-coupling and its non-minimal gravitational coupling, produce enough primordial black holes to explain dark matter while satisfying CMB and particle-physics constraints?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Can a hidden confining sector motivated by string constructions supply dark matter through glueballs?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Can an ultralight scalar preserve successful large-scale dark-matter behavior while altering small-scale structure? The supplied text identifies a 10⁻²²–10⁻²¹ eV mass range but ends before explaining the mechanism or connecting it quantitatively to wormholes.

sources.title: Violation of the equivalence principle from light scalar dark matter

evidence.text: What local clock-comparison and differential-acceleration signatures arise when light scalar dark matter couples linearly or quadratically to Standard Model sectors, and what coupling limits follow from the existing measurements used in this 2018 analysis?

sources.title: Rescuing Massive Photons from the Swampland

evidence.text: Can inflationary fluctuations produce all dark matter as a light vector while its scalar partners and ultraviolet cutoff remain above the inflationary Hubble scale?

sources.title: Dark Photon Dark Matter from a Network of Cosmic Strings

evidence.text: Can a cosmic string network formed by the same symmetry breaking that generates a dark photon mass produce the observed abundance of ultralight, nonrelativistic vector dark matter?

sources.title: Constraints on millicharged dark matter and axionlike particles from timing of radio waves

evidence.text: Can dispersion of radio pulses and time variation of their polarization constrain millicharged dark matter and ultralight axion-like dark matter through their effects during propagation?

sources.title: Fine Tuning, Sequestering, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can partially sequestered hidden sectors support dark matter or quintessence while remaining weakly coupled to visible matter? The paper offers this as model-building motivation and reports external coupling restrictions without deriving numerical bounds.

sources.title: Probing Dynamics of Boson Stars by Fast Radio Bursts and Gravitational Wave Detection

evidence.text: Do selected boson-star configurations satisfy the adopted field-range and potential-gradient conjectures?

sources.title: Dark Horse, Dark Matter: Revisiting the $SO$(16)x $SO$(16)' Nonsupersymmetric Model in the LHC and Dark Energy Era

evidence.text: Could hidden bound states in the compactified orthogonal gauge theory provide dark matter, and could the bifundamental connector make them observable? The relevant unknowns include confinement scales, stability, production, decay and reheating history.

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: Can a decreasing exchanged-scalar mass increase dark-matter scattering without appreciably varying the dark-matter mass?

sources.title: New Limits on Charged Dark Matter from Large-Scale Coherent Magnetic Fields

evidence.text: Can cumulative angular-momentum transfer from a rotating, magnetized galactic ISM to a more slowly rotating charged dark-matter halo constrain the dark-matter charge-to-mass ratio through the absence of severe gas-disk contraction?

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: Can the primordial HST black-hole gas evolve into a surviving mass distribution consistent with observations and potentially supply dark matter?

sources.title: Subaru-HSC through a different lens: Microlensing by extended dark matter structures

evidence.text: How do simultaneous finite lens and source sizes change microlensing magnification and Subaru-HSC constraints on extended dark matter populations, particularly NFW subhalos and boson stars at asteroid-to-Earth masses?

sources.title: Dark Matter and Dark Radiation

evidence.text: Estimate additional effects using dipole bremsstrahlung, Thomson drag from dark radiation, and the linear Weibel growth rate associated with anisotropic plasma velocities. Nonlinear plasma evolution is not calculated.

sources.title: Searching for the light dark gauge boson in GeV-scale experiments

evidence.text: Collider estimates use MadGraph QED backgrounds, Monte Carlo on-shell U production and decay, geometric cuts, and Gaussian detector smearing. Visible branching fractions are inferred from measured electromagnetic R values; the pion channel uses an empirical pion form factor.

sources.title: New cosmological constraints on primordial black holes

evidence.text: The extragalactic photon calculation integrates evolving PBH emission over cosmic time with redshift and propagation limits. Abundance caps touch upper 1σ observational error tips; known astrophysical contributions are not subtracted.

sources.title: Dark Matter Candidates from Particle Physics and Methods of Detection

evidence.text: Thermal relic abundances are obtained numerically from dn/dt = −3Hn − ⟨σAv⟩(n²−neq²), with an approximate freeze-out criterion n⟨σAv⟩ = H. Chemical freeze-out is distinguished from kinetic decoupling.

sources.title: Dynamical Dark Matter: I. Theoretical Overview

evidence.text: Prompt decays and a continuum density of lifetimes permit analytic abundance evolution. Numerical calculations use tower eigenvalues without the asymptotic overlap approximations; effective equations of state are extracted from numerical logarithmic slopes.

sources.title: Double-Disk Dark Matter

evidence.text: Tracks separately conserved visible/dark entropy after thermal decoupling, estimates additional effective neutrino species and applies standard analytic thermal-freezeout calculations to the heavy symmetric relic.

sources.title: Challenging the Stability of Light Millicharged Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can electrically neutral, very light charged scalar dark matter remain cosmologically stable when its large occupation numbers enhance particle–antiparticle annihilation into gauge bosons? The paper examines direct electromagnetic coupling and coupling through kinetic mixing with a massless hidden photon.

sources.title: Typicality Defended

evidence.text: Associate each conscious perception with a positive operator and evaluate its expectation in the quantum state. Additive equal contributions from repeated regions can then reproduce count-based observational odds.

sources.title: Typicality Defended

evidence.text: Replace a complicated likelihood-optimal parameter by a nearby power of two, encode its exponent, and evaluate the resulting likelihood loss. The paper develops this operation only for its geometric observation model and assumed coding comparison.

sources.title: Typicality Defended

evidence.text: Use an observational sampling model as an inference rule without postulating a physical selection mechanism. The paper motivates this through self-sampling principles and an analogy with probabilistic prediction in an Everettian account.

sources.title: Typicality Defended

evidence.text: For each theory, multiply its prior by the probability of the observed data, then normalize over theories. The paper applies this standard operation to distinguish effects of observational weighting from assumptions about theoretical simplicity.

sources.title: The Swampland Conjecture Bound Conjecture

evidence.text: Which low-energy effective field theories can admit a consistent ultraviolet completion in quantum gravity? The paper adopts the landscape/swampland terminology as the setting for a different question about the information required to formulate conjectures.

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for the Effective Field Theories with N Species

evidence.text: How is the gauge weak-gravity cutoff altered when N separated abelian gauge sectors share the same bulk gravity?

sources.title: Populating the swampland: The Case of U(1)**496 and E(8) x U(1)**248

evidence.text: Do U(1)^496 and E8×U(1)^248 ten-dimensional supergravities possess quantum-gravity completions? The paper tests requirements on compactification moduli spaces and on the fate of supersymmetric naked singularities, without assuming a string construction.

sources.title: String Universality in Six Dimensions

evidence.text: Do low-energy consistency conditions characterize the six-dimensional supersymmetric quantum-gravity theories, and does every such consistent theory admit a string compactification? The paper tests this through anomaly constraints, explicit K3 constructions and apparently exceptional infinite families.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Supergravity and String Vacua in Various Dimensions

evidence.text: How strongly does quantum consistency constrain low-energy supersymmetric theories coupled to gravity, and how closely do those constraints match known string constructions in dimensions 10, 8, and 6?

evidence.text: Can the two abelian-containing polynomial candidates be completed into quantum gravity?

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture and effective field theory

evidence.text: Does satisfying a Weak Gravity Conjecture in a higher-energy gauge theory ensure its validity after Higgsing, and what weaker constraint on gauge EFTs might survive when conventional WGC bounds fail?

evidence.text: Which apparently consistent effective theories can admit a UV completion with dynamical gravity? The lectures formulate this as distinguishing the string landscape from the Swampland.

evidence.text: Which massless charge spectra of six-dimensional N = 1 supergravity with one gauged U(1) satisfy known consistency tests, and which can arise in F-theory?

evidence.text: Do anomaly cancellation and other known consistency conditions bound the massless charge spectra of 6D supergravity with one U(1), and how do these spectra compare with F-theory realizations and Higgsed nonabelian theories?

evidence.text: Which gauge couplings and theta angles of an infrared photon coupled to gravity admit a consistent ultraviolet completion?

sources.title: Theta-problem and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Can a quantum-gravity completion permit continuously adjustable couplings that are independent of scalar expectation values?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Which conjectured quantum-gravity constraints can be tested by a controlled compactification limit with a weak gauge interaction and finite gravitational coupling?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Does this abelian spectrum exhibit the charge sublattice expected from the Sublattice Weak Gravity Conjecture? The source reports maximally superextremal states on a spacing-eight sublattice in the F2 example.

sources.title: Do We Live in the Swampland?

evidence.text: Can the Standard Model and small extensions admit a quantum-gravity UV completion when a conjectured bound constrains the full scalar potential throughout the effective field theory domain?

sources.title: Distance and de Sitter Conjectures on the Swampland

evidence.text: What happens to the spectrum when scalar moduli traverse parametrically large proper distances? The conjecture predicts exponentially descending towers, so the low-energy spectrum cannot remain fixed throughout the limit.

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: Can a positive stationary point with vanishing first and second derivatives still admit an order-one potential drop within an order-one field distance?

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: What can the shape of a positive multifield potential constrain without specifying cosmological initial conditions? The paper studies gradient, tachyon and finite-distance descent diagnostics, with lengths measured using the scalar kinetic metric.

sources.title: Quintessence Axion Revisited in Light of Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Does ultraviolet quantum gravity select the theta boundary condition, or must all fixed-theta vacua be considered? The paper assumes the latter, making possible positive-energy members of the theta family part of its motivation for a dynamical field.

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for the Effective Field Theories with N Species

evidence.text: Divide S < EL by E and insert the relativistic gas ratio S/E. This produces the lower size bound needed to test compatibility with the independently derived collapse upper bound.

sources.title: Populating the swampland: The Case of U(1)**496 and E(8) x U(1)**248

evidence.text: Shift the seed's asymptotic radius above one, rotate its charge into a ten-dimensional gauge U(1), and rescale the final internal modulus. This isolates a finite Wilson-line-zero locus outside the repulson without relying on geometric self-duality there.

sources.title: String Universality in Six Dimensions

evidence.text: Use group trace identities to remove irreducible tr F^4 anomalies, then solve Green–Schwarz factorization of the remaining polynomial. For the worked model the irreducible constraints are M−BN=8 and 2N−A(N−8)−BM=0.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Supergravity and String Vacua in Various Dimensions

evidence.text: Green–Schwarz anomaly cancellation uses factorization of anomaly polynomials and exchange of two-form fields. In 6D, I8 = ½ Ωαβ X4α X4β with Ω of signature (1,T). Legible constraints include H−V = 273−29T, a·a = 9−T, and proper-sign gauge kinetic terms requiring j·bi > 0.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture and effective field theory

evidence.text: Track gauge-boson mass eigenstates and the surviving charge lattice after Higgsing, then iterate the construction through a chain of Abelian gauge groups.

sources.title: Super-Planckian Spatial Field Variations and Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: For strong curvature, the authors rewrite the metric and scalar using H1 and H2 and analyze the trace of Einstein's equation. Restricting these functions to Laplacian eigenfunctions leads to logarithmic behavior near relevant poles.

sources.title: The tameness of quantum field theory: Part I - Amplitudes

evidence.text: Can o-minimal definability provide a generalized finiteness principle for QFT observables, including singular limits, and how far does perturbative tameness extend to exact observables, RG flow, and effective theories compatible with quantum gravity?

sources.title: Gravitational correction and weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can comparing gravitational and gauge contributions to the running coupling provide a quantum-level interpretation of the weak gravity conjecture, including non-Abelian theories, higher dimensions and large extra dimensions?

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Implications of Quantum Gravity for Particle Physics

evidence.text: Review how quantum-gravity consistency conditions constrain low-energy EFT and might inform strong CP, the weak scale, new gauge interactions and dark energy. The white paper explicitly does not guarantee that gravitational considerations solve these problems.
